purpose: Supplemental synthetic final evaluation only; never VCM training, selection, calibration, enrollment or human qualification

upstream_snapshot.role: Pinned original source provenance; generation uses the separately pinned ONNX mirror, not these PT weights

weights_license: Apache-2.0 upstream; preserve upstream notices; mirror card MIT is not a relicensing of weights
voice_metadata_source: Upstream VOICES.md preset labels; not inferred human demographics or independent human speakers
device: CPUExecutionProvider by default; explicit --provider cuda uses CUDAExecutionProvider with CPUExecutionProvider for unsupported operators and must verify CUDA availability and session initialization; no silent provider downgrade
execution_provider_policy: CPU or explicitly requested CUDA is a tooling choice recorded with actual session providers and CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES; the waveform grid, references, QA and final-evaluation isolation are unchanged
worker_policy: Explicit --workers 1..8, default 1; additional workers use independent spawned processes, sessions and tokenizers on the same inherited single visible GPU. Fixed seed, trim=false and one take per planned waveform; parent metadata sorted by waveform identity. Failed worker results are preserved or reported without retries or dropped grid cells. Worker count is a tooling choice frozen and recorded before generation, never an outcome-driven change.
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly up=2 down=3; PCM_16 WAV; no truncation or prompt padding
waveform_identity: SHA-256 of canonical [voice_id, exact_spoken_text, speed]; duplicate speech shares one waveform only within the same voice and speed
scope: Every preserved supported/negative OptionB case, personal extension and catalog extra from the unchanged bound contract, at all six voices and all three speeds; retain every source reference
inference_input: WAV bytes only, through AudioService and IntentSlotsRuntime; expected labels stay outside inference
quality_review: Every unique WAV independently listened to before any VCM results; exact words, no clipping/truncation/artifacts; quality at least 4/5; bind reviewer, timestamp and SHA-256
synthetic_pass_gate: 100% accepted exact typed positives and correct specified negative rejections, every voice, speed and track, with no faults, missing outputs, missing QA or missing cases
physical_pi: deferred by user; official live benchmark and room playback are not simulated accuracy evidence
failure_policy: Preserve every native synthesis output, including capture-length/format failures, before QA. Never cherry-pick cases or outcomes, resynthesize failures using VCM results, edit prompts/references, change thresholds or fit on this suite. Corrections require a new version/directory with original evidence preserved. Any follow-up model needs fresh independent final confirmation.
